purpose: One goal-bound agent walk maximum until independently observed needs/career/skills/whims action; separate camera VOI and physical navigation.

walk_contract.purpose: WALK is transit, never a terminal value and never an information-gathering gesture.
walk_contract.entry: Current actor, objective, target, domain, positive affordance, active on-lot scene, source-bound queue and current route evidence
walk_contract.repeat_guard: A prior walk since last observed domain action blocks another walk even after the queue empties.
walk_contract.terminal: NEEDS|CAREER|SKILLS|WHIMS action with same goal and target is separately observed, not assumed from arrival.

camera_contract.motion: View-only pan/zoom/reframe, no physical Sim position or Sim queue mutation
camera_contract.evidence: Fresh capture/camera revision and independently admitted named camera lease
camera_contract.restore: Existing active Sim follow and safe cursor rest, never leave camera off intent

learning_boundary.admissible: Versioned, consented, source-bound reviewed outcomes may calibrate VOI cost and benefit
learning_boundary.prediction: Never replaces fresh verified route, goal, player and effect permits

harness.handoff: CHANGED | PROVED | NEXT, PR/commit/CI separate from local gameplay
